findings.message: "Yes" says nothing about the action. A button is a verb plus a noun, for example "Save board".
marginLeft is physical and does not mirror in RTL. Use marginStart.
padding: 12 is a literal in a styles file. Read it from the theme object argument (only 0, 1 and percentages may be written).
padding: 12 is a literal in a style. Read it from the theme in <Name>.styles.ts.
backgroundColor: '#ffffff' is a literal in a style. Read it from the theme in <Name>.styles.ts.
em dash (escaped) near " return <Text>{'Boards <here> recent'}</Text>; ". Use a comma, colon, period or parentheses.
Button tone="primary" is not a value of the manifest. Use one of: neutral, accent, danger, success, warning, info.
Button start takes Icon, not <View>. Instead use: IconButton (only an icon); Link (navigation inside text).
Button size="xs" is 24px, under the 44pt (iOS) and 48dp (Android) touch target. Use sm or larger in a touch template.
